title: Captured German nuclear scientists wiretapped in an English country house
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Captured German nuclear scientists wiretapped in an English country house, about 1945 at English countryside, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: program. What's interesting about him is he and all the people on his nuclear program were captured like you said and they were put I believe in the English countryside and they the whole house was wiretapped

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that after World War Two in 1945, the German physicist Werner Heisenberg and the others on Germany's nuclear program were captured and held in a house in the English countryside. According to Michels, the whole house was wiretapped, and transcripts of their talks were made. He raises it in a conversation with a guest, Jason Jorjani, who claims Hitler had a secret UFO program, since the recordings might show what the German scientists really knew.
